title: Views or instants: reproducibility archive for frame-budget allocation in multi-camera path-length measurement
description:
Reproducibility archive for the revised Measurement Science and Technology manuscript on allocating camera views and sampling instants under a frame-processing budget.

Version 1.0.3 adds an exploratory two-to-seven-view grid at four budget caps, noise-parameter and reference-resolution sensitivity, whole-record deletion, original frozen decision reporting and an audit of conditional eligibility in the non-uniform sampling experiment. At 84 frames, three-view MAE is 9.60 mm versus 50.77 mm for seven views, and this ordering persists under the tested sensitivities. At 168 frames, the tested three-view schedule instead gives 85.66 mm versus 10.55 mm, because of rare large errors. Thus no universal three-view prescription is supported. All new analyses are exploratory; original frozen protocols and sealed prediction files remain unchanged.

notes: The manuscript is prepared for submission and has not been finally submitted. Version 1.0.3 contains 1680 new window configurations and verifies 288 estimates against the archived results, with zero numerical difference. New analyses are exploratory after prior results were examined. The original frozen protocols, predictions and decision records are preserved. No third-party image datasets or model weights are redistributed. Calibration matrices and input hashes support reproducibility.
